title: The claim floor refuses an item whose declared dependency has not landed
summary: ADR-0106 W3 stopped offering dependency-blocked items in every menu, but nothing enforces it where the pick becomes a claim: a triage run that names a waiting id anyway (from a scout report, carryover, or the dependency_blocked note) builds ahead of its dependency. Design doc §7.7 W7.
acceptance: inboxmover's claim floor refuses a pending item whose PendingDispatchability is not dispatchable, naming the blocker, as it already refuses a console-routed item.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: the claim floor is the last line against building ahead of an unlanded dependency, and nothing enforces it there today
